findings.detail: Example C heading says equal coupons; body correctly stipulates400 versus450. No numerical or substantive translation error.
Replaced regime de juros definitivos with regime de tributação definitiva dos juros: final qualifies tax treatment, not the interest itself. English, formulas and numbers unchanged.
Replaced alerte o objeto with alerte quem está sob suspeita: subject refers to the party under investigation, not an object. English, numbers and legal meaning preserved.

Objective now distinguishes unusual activity from a conclusion that an offence occurred, rather than infração concluída, which could suggest completed rather than attempted conduct. Body already correctly preserves suspicion/proof distinction.
Authoritative current sources now fontes atuais e reconhecidas como confiáveis, replacing autorizadas which could mean permission rather than source authority. English and all numbers unchanged.
Latest reported periodic27% observation no longer says ocasionalmente: happens to be describes the observed figure, not a claim about frequency. Minimum10% versus client20% distinction preserved.
